title: Closeout summary: S01T04 - Define SemVer, schema compatibility, migration, and rollback contracts
body:
## Agent Finish Summary

Published a machine-readable 0.x compatibility matrix and normative SemVer/migration/rollback policy; hardened storage migration with preflight reporting, timestamped backup-before-activation, stable record ordering, exact content-hash parity, event-log verification, inverse commands, and failure diagnostics.

Close reason: SemVer, schema compatibility, migration, content parity, backup, and rollback contracts are implemented, documented, and tested.
